ms.report:
We hired a full stack developer with front-end experience with other Cardano projects as a full-time contractor: https://www.linkedin.com/in/talhahussain7/ .
Working with our team he created multiple mock-ups of for our portal to add the community section. He designed a version with just a voting section in the forum, an external link to Clarity to vote on issues there. We are moving forward implementing one of the designs with both a forum voting mechanism that requires C3 token and an external DAO link. 
Here is a video/demo of multiple design mock-ups to allow community members to vote, it was recorded by Talha our new hire as evidence that he is working on the project! https://vimeo.com/935739429?share=copy
Completed outputs:

ms.report:
In order to achieve this milestone, we needed to implement either a forum or DAO voting section and launch 5 feeds from pre-proposal. 
・Since project launch, we've launched the following feeds NEWM/USD NMKR/ADA BOOK/USD ADA/CHF and ADA/EURO; these can be viewed here: https://portal.charli3.io/dev/feeds
・Our ecosystem has enjoyed a 100% uptime with only 7 feed updates delayed by more than 20 seconds in the entire history of our service (Launched Oct 2022); view full report here on performance to date: https://drive.google.com/file/d/17iKhoHtAgVzTy5xjiCB0_y8fl5OwXC7t/view
・Please find the updated forum/dao voting section on our developer portal here: https://portal.charli3.io/dev/community/forum

UPDATED: Forum
Our milestone requires either a forum with a voting section OR a DAO voting section, but not necessarily both. 
To access the forum voting section, please do the following:
a. goto the website URL to find two tabs "Public Discussions" and "Charli3-DAO Community" 
Note that the Charli3-DAO Community section will have a "lock symbol" on it until you connect your wallet holding C3 Token.
b. Select "Charli3-DAO Community" and users MUST input their wallet to proceed -- access to this section is restricted to only token holders. 
Note that the lock will be "unlocked" and you will get a notice that you have successfully entered the section
Upon entering the section you will find at least one poll to illustrate the functionality.

Please note that this is a temporary solution with limited functionality (e.g. MVP) until we employ a third party solution like Clarity. It is likely the forum and voting will change in the next iteration to support temperature checks and discussions. Voting is limited to Yes/No questions at this time.

ms.report:
DELIVERABLE 1: DAO + Vote
The Charli3 team created a DAO in the summer of 2024, directly after submitting milestone 2 POA, and ran a temperature check with the newly formed DAO allowing them to vote on the clarity/summons platform to approve/deny us putting in a change request for the project (Reducing feed launches from 25 to 5 ensuring high demand feeds stay up for longer).
=====================EVIDENCE OF REQUIREMENT CHANGE AND VOTE WITH 200+ SUBMISSIONS===========================

VOTE EVIDENCE: https://drive.google.com/file/d/17oPA_ms9Mc17d0PalAwOaCJE8wvC9xpB/view?usp=sharing

・272 Votes to change requirements, 1 vote against, several abstaining

DELIVERABLE 2: Price Feed Launches
This milestone period lasted from May 2024 to June 2025. During this time we launched 5 feeds on mainnet for milestone 3. The mainnet details are available below. From the period Sep 8 2025 to Jan 30 2025, we ran 10 total feeds on mainnet (feeds launched from milestones 1-3). Since Jan 30 2025, some feeds have converted to pre-production or have been terminated for several reason (financial, lack of demand, or etc.). The details of such changes are part of the deliverables in Milestone 4. The change request document contains precise financial details and costs associated with the oracle price feeds.
Sep 8 2025 – Jan 30 2025: 10 feeds remain live on mainnet during the milestone period.
